# PROBLEM DESCRIPTION

A small update to the GacUICompiler test project and the GacGen tool. Now the GacUI XML Resource Compiler already supports detecting is there any RPC defined in workflow interfaces, and generate C++ code. But we also want to metadata. There is two kind of metadata, you can checkout Workflow repo's CompilerTest\_LoadAndCompile test project, and see there are many files generated to Workflow/Test/Generated/RpcMetadata(32|64), one is Metadata\_*.txt containing extracted RPC definition in Workflow script, another is Serialization.d*.ts containing TypeScript types as schema which are actually used in RPC's JSON protocol implementation. These two files may not needed when the hosting and requesting side are all C++, but when we want to implement view models in a different language, these files are required so that we can write codegen in that language. So two things to update:

For GacUICompiler, in GacUI/Test/GacUISrc/Generated\_\<APP-NAME>/Resource\_(x64|x86), when RPC is used, print RpcMetadata.txt and RpcMetadata.d.ts, just like how CompilerTest\_LoadAndCompile detect and generate.

For GacGen, do the same thing, you will find that temporary files also printed to a folder \<RESOURCE-XML>.log/(x32|x64), when RPC is available, RpcMetadata.txt and RpcMetadata.d.ts will also stay there.

To verify, after running GacUICompiler you should see 4 more files appearing in the RemoteViewModelTest resource folder. You cannot treat RemoteViewModelTest folder special, you must really detect if RPC is used. in GacUICompiler. There are already code generating RPC related cpp files, if special treatment already there, you should fix it, otherwise the detection part should already be reuseable. And for GacGen tool, run it against Test/Resources/App/(RemoteProtocolTest|RemoteViewModelTest), and you should see log folder created, verify content of those folders and find out there is no RPC related files created for RemoteProtocolTest, and there are RPC related files created for RemoteViewModelTest. Pay attention to RemoteViewModelTest, RPC related C++ files should also be created. All files created by running GacGen should be removed, as in each GacGenConfig there is SourceFolder and Resource, source folder will store created C++ files, resource will store the binary resource file name, these files are not needed, so you should clean them up.

No unit test is needed as this task does not change any actual source code, but pay attention to all files that are changed, no existing C++ files should be change due to running codegen although codegen rewrite them.

Once finishing, commit and push all local changes. At the end, tell me the list of all files generated by GacGen against RemoteViewModelTest (which will be later cleaned up as required in this task)

## No.1 Emit validated RPC metadata beside the existing RPC outputs

Both callers already use `HasRpcMetadata(compiled)` to select RPC C++ generation after the aggregate `Instance_GenerateRpcMetadata` pass. Reuse that validated signal and the same `compiled->metadata->rpcMetadata` object used by the existing RPC generator. Print `metadataModule` with `WfPrint` and write its `dts` field directly, matching Workflow's `CompilerTest_LoadAndCompile` artifacts. Keep file placement caller-specific: the GacUI compiler's architecture resource folder and GacGen's architecture log folder. Delete stale GacUI metadata before each compile so non-RPC resources cannot retain old artifacts.

### CODE CHANGE

Updated only the GacUI compiler test project and GacGen tool call sites. `CompileResources` now deletes stale metadata in each architecture resource folder, prints the validated aggregate metadata module, and writes `RpcMetadata.txt` plus `RpcMetadata.d.ts` after successful RPC C++ generation. `CompileResource` does the same in the current GacGen architecture log folder and includes both files in its known-RPC-output cleanup. No library/compiler implementation or unit test changed.

### CONFIRMED

- `GacUISrc.sln` built successfully for Debug x64 with zero warnings and errors after the change. `GacGen.sln` built successfully for Debug x64 and Release x64 with zero warnings and errors.
- The final `GacUI_Compiler` run completed successfully for both architectures and produced exactly `RpcMetadata.txt` and `RpcMetadata.d.ts` under both `Generated_RemoteViewModelTest/Resource_x86` and `Resource_x64`. No other generated application received either file.
- The x86 and x64 metadata pairs are identical, contain `rvmt::IViewModel` and its `Translate` method, and match the corresponding GacGen outputs byte-for-byte. Both generated TypeScript declaration files passed TypeScript 6.0.2 strict no-emit checking.
- The baseline and final compiler runs produced identical hashes for all four rewritten RemoteViewModelTest binary resource files. Those unrelated rewrites were restored. No existing generated C++ file differs from `HEAD`.
- GacGen `/C32` and `/C64` runs for RemoteProtocolTest produced no `RpcMetadata*`, RPC C++, or RPC platform contract files. The corresponding runs for RemoteViewModelTest produced both metadata files per architecture, staged both RPC C++ files plus the architecture contract, and published the merged RPC C++ pair in its configured source folder.
- All GacGen log/staging folders and temporary CLI-wrapper files were removed. The configured `Test/UIRes/RemoteViewModelTest.bin` target was attempted by GacGen, but `Test/UIRes` does not exist and no binary file was created. Re-running x32 last restored every pre-existing RemoteViewModelTest source file byte-for-byte.
